input.prompt:
3D Pixar-style animated film, vertical 9:16, blazing sunny seaside, rich detail, shallow depth of field. Keep every character exactly as in the reference images and never stretch or change proportions: Fizz the green frog (image 1), the caramel bunny with green scarf (image 2), Bucky the brown beaver (image 3), Croco the green crocodile (image 4), the penguin ice-cream vendor with striped apron and paper hat (image 5); setting: the seaside boardwalk with the ice-cream cart (image 6). Five hard-cut shots, each starts with immediate action.
Shot 1 (0-3s) hook: extreme close-up of the four melting in the heat: sweat drops sizzle and steam on the hot planks, Croco fans himself with a palm leaf, Fizz's tongue hangs out, Bucky wrings sweat out of his tail, Bunny fans herself with her scarf; all four stare desperately at the ice-cream cart.
Shot 2 (3-6s): the penguin slides four giant cones across the counter with a flourish: Fizz a triple strawberry, the bunny an orange carrot scoop, Bucky vanilla with a chocolate dip, Croco a scoop as big as his head; they snatch them with huge grins.
Shot 3 (6-9s): the four bite at exactly the same moment, one beat of pure bliss with closed eyes, then all their eyes snap open and cross.
Shot 4 (9-12s): brain freeze chain: hands slap foreheads, a loud ice crackle runs across Fizz, then the bunny, Bucky and Croco in turn, frost creeping over fur and skin until all four are glittering ice statues with frozen screaming faces.
Shot 5 (12-15s): the penguin, who never tastes his own ice-cream, rubs his flippers with a smug grin and taps a statue so it rings like glass; the sun beats down, drips fall, cracks run across the statues and Croco's ice mask falls off in chunks, his teary eyes wide.
Sound design only, absolutely no music: seaside waves and gulls, sizzling heat, crunchy bites, chained ice crackle, glass-tapping rings, dripping meltwater, squeaky yelps, small comic boing accents synced to every action.
